items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: These guys play with Beyoncé, they play with Alicia Keys.

ctx.x: When you were trying to get known in the music scene, did you play gigs that you might not have anticipated playing: weddings and so forth and so on?

Yeah I did. The first couple of years I did some club dates with some kind of party bands and, which for me was fine because as I kind of touched upon earlier I did a lot of commercial work in Australia so I was no stranger to playing in horn sections. Like I used to play in the band for Australian Idol which is our equivalent to American Idol, so I’d done a lot of commercial work. I knew a lot of the pop tunes. So you know that was kind of a side of me that I had good experience of doing. I’ve kind of shed that…
Wow that’s a strong statement. So what do you want to be the best at?
